claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II is a crewed mission.
Artemis II mission is now underway.
Artemis II mission sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The rocket for Artemis II is Space Launch System (SLS).
The spacecraft for Artemis II is Orion.
The launch location for Artemis II is Launch Complex 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The crew of Artemis II consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
SpaceX Starlink 10-58 is scheduled for Thursday, April 2, 2026.
The launch window for SpaceX Starlink 10-58 is from 7:52 a.m. to 11:52 p.m.
SpaceX Starlink 10-58 launch is at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
